title: Emergency, governor's rule imposed in KP as president approves cabinet decision

article.title: Emergency, governor's rule imposed in KP as president approves cabinet decision
article.summary: Key developments: Emergency imposed under Article 232 , governor’s rule under Article 234 Cabinet recommended move due to KP govt’s ‘ deliberate disengagement from the fight against terrorism’ Technocratic council formed ; Fakhr Alam appointed as KP chief secretary PTI’s Gohar condemns decision as undemocratic, says peace cannot be established by weakening provincial autonomy Governor Kundi calls for unity for ‘new chapter’ in KP’s development ISLAMABAD: The federal government on Sunday imposed an emergency and governor’s rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa following the president’s approval of the recommendations by the federal cabinet. The measures have been approved under Articles 232 and 234 of the Constitution, the President House said in a statement. The two provisions pertain to the proclamation of emergency and governor’s rule. Following the imposition, internet disruptions were being reported from parts of Peshawar, with Dawn unable to contact its correspondents there. According to sources in the telecom sector, mobile network and data services have been slowed or shut down in selected areas of some cities.
